newsitem.title: USA: Toyota unit to open service center in Iowa.
newsitem.headline: Toyota unit to open service center in Iowa.

text.p: Toyota Motor Credit Corp said it will open a new national customer service station in the Cedar Rapids area that will create 200 new jobs over the next three years.

Toyota Motor Credit is a unit of Toyota Motor Corp's Toyota Motor Sales U.S.A. Inc, headquartered in Torrance, Calif. It provides retail leasing, retail and wholesale financing and certain other financial services to authorized U.S. Toyota, Lexus and Toyota industrial equipment dealers.
It said the new center will open late this year or early in 1998.
